name: Lethal Ape: Original
summary: Lethal Ape: Original is a fast-paced VR movement game inspired by Gorilla Tag. Set in a minimalistic forest environment, players swing, climb, and chase each other using only their arms—no buttons or sticks. The central feature is a large tree stump, offering vertical gameplay and hiding spots. With no frills and pure tag action, it’s all about movement, momentum, and mastering the terrain to escape or catch your friends. Simple, chaotic fun.
